name: Ammunition (Arrow Tube): Bamboo Shaft
body:
These foot-long arrows are used as ammunition for arrow tubes.

Benefit: As an improvised melee weapon, they deal damage equivalent to a spiked gauntlet. They come in a bamboo tube that holds 10 shafts.
